assets.title: The Nightcap Glass
assets.content: Cornelius Vane's brandy glass, still on his bedside table. A faint bitter sediment clings to the bottom — not the residue ordinary brandy leaves.

assets.title: The Surgeon's Syringe
assets.content: A used glass syringe found tucked in the ship surgeon's medical bag. It has been wiped, but a trace of plant-derived extract remains in the barrel.

assets.title: The Purser's Ledger
assets.content: The ship's account book. Several entries under Vane's name have been altered, and a hold manifest lists cargo that does not appear on the official record.

assets.title: The Torn Telegram
assets.content: A half-burned draft of a wireless message from Vane to his solicitor: '...changing everything in the mor—'. The rest is ash.

assets.title: The Empty Vial
assets.content: A small empty bottle labelled 'Digitalis — Tinct.', found hidden behind the washbasin in the ship surgeon's private cabin. Enough was in it to stop a strong man's heart.

assets.title: The Stopped Clock
assets.content: The clock in Vane's stateroom stopped at 2:14 — knocked, perhaps, as he fell. The hour of death is not what the surgeon first reported.

assets.title: No Gulls
assets.content: The sailors mutter that no gulls have followed the ship since the death. Out here in the deep Atlantic, they say, the only predators left aboard are the human kind.

assets.title: The Heart That Did Not Fail
assets.content: A second, careful look at the body tells its own story: the lividity and the dilated pupils point not to a failing heart but to a powerful drug. Someone who knew medicine signed a certificate they knew was false.

assets.title: The Unsteady Hand
assets.content: Whoever administered the dose had access to surgical tools and the skill to use them — and hands that, lately, have not been entirely steady.

assets.title: The Doctor's Habit
assets.content: A stewardess whispers that Dr. Pierce keeps very odd hours and that his hands shake before he's had his 'medicine'. Some say he takes more than he prescribes.

assets.title: Cargo in the Dark
assets.content: A deckhand will tell you, for a price, that the purser was down in the forward hold the night of the death, moving crates that aren't on any manifest.

assets.title: Words After Dinner
assets.content: Half the dining saloon heard Mrs. Vane and her husband exchange cold words that last evening. She left the table early; he did not follow.

assets.title: The Smoking-Room Argument
assets.content: A steward recalls Dr. Pierce and Mr. Vane exchanging sharp words in the smoking room, and an envelope of cash changing hands afterward.

assets.title: On the Boat Deck
assets.content: Two stewards have separately seen Mrs. Vane and young Mr. Theodore on the boat deck after midnight, standing far too close for relations.
